idea-plugin.name: Dienstanweisung Bewachung
idea-plugin.description:
Pflichtinhalte nach § 17, 18, 20 BewachV und § 34a Abs. 1a GewO

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Dienstanweisung Bewachung: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/dienstanweisung-bewachung-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com

action.description: Run Dienstanweisung Bewachung on the file in the editor
